claims.text: Many reviewers report reduced shedding, less fallout, and stronger or thicker-feeling hair after use.
Several reviewers report visible new hair growth or filling in of thinning areas, including edges and crown.
Reviewers frequently praise the light, pleasant scent and the easy spray application that isn't oily or greasy.
A few reviewers note negatives: a small bottle for the price, a greasy feel on dry hair, an unpleasant smell, and unclear instructions.
Some reviewers say it is too early to tell whether the product is actually helping.

qa.q: Does it actually help with hair growth or thinning?
qa.answer: Reviews are mixed on regrowth: some report new hair growth [3][5] and faster growth [2], while one says it did not regrow hair in thin spots [1] and another is unsure about stimulating growth [6]. Several report fuller, thicker, or healthier-looking hair and less fallout [1][4][6].

claims.text: Some users report new hair growth where sprayed [3][5] and faster growth [2].
One reviewer says it did not regrow hair in thin spots [1], and another is unsure about stimulating growth [6].
Reviewers report hair looking healthier and fuller, thicker and stronger, and less fallout [1][4][6].

qa.q: How often should I use it and how long until I see results?
qa.answer: Reviews describe varied usage: one used it twice a day for a month [1], another used it daily [4], and another about four times a week for 1.5 months [6]. Results timelines ranged from over two weeks [3] to over a month [2] to about 1.5 months [6].

claims.text: One reviewer used it twice a day for a month [1].
One reviewer used it daily [4].
One reviewer used it about four times a week for 1.5 months [6].
One reviewer saw results after more than two weeks [3].
One reviewer used it over a month [2].
One reviewer noticed new growth after about 1.5 months [6].

qa.q: Does it make hair greasy or leave residue?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: one reviewer says it leaves hair shiny and not greasy [1], while another reports a greasy feel when used on dry hair [6]. A third reviewer notes you have to wash it off after massaging it in [4].

claims.text: It leaves hair shiny and not greasy.
Used on dry hair, it had a bit of a greasy feel.
You will have to wash it off after massaging it in.

qa.q: Is it safe for color-treated or sensitive scalp?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: How strong is the smell and does it linger?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on the smell: some find it unpleasant but bearable and note it rinses out [1][2], while others describe it as a light, fresh, great scent [4][5][6]. On lingering, one reviewer says the smell doesn't matter much since you wash it off after massaging [2], but no review directly states whether it lingers.

claims.text: Some reviewers find the smell not great but bearable, and note it rinses out or is washed off [1][2].
Other reviewers describe the smell as light, fresh, and great [4][5][6].
